context.transcript:
Next on the management team agenda is a proposal to update the packaging for our breakfast cereals.
Some of our cereals have lost popularity in recent years and could definitely use a new look.
But as for Purple Berry Crunch, that remains a very popular brand.
It's still on the breakfast table of many homes across the country.
So I suggest we start by looking at our other cereal boxes one at a time.
I prepared a few slides on each product.
I'll share those with the group now.
context.transcript_translation:
管理团队议程上的下一个项目是关于更新我们早餐谷物包装的提案。
我们的某些谷物近年来失去了人气，绝对需要新的外观。
但就紫莓脆（Purple Berry Crunch）而言，它仍然是一个非常受欢迎的品牌。
它在全国许多家庭的餐桌上依然存在。
所以我建议我们从逐一查看其他谷物盒开始。
我为每种产品准备了几张幻灯片。
我现在将与小组分享这些。
